scenario: [LTIM.5.1] (LTIM.12.7, the id, is a tombstone): `<` is defined for `Time`, so `t1.fired_at < t2.fired_at` compiles. That the comparison is on `utc_ns` (LTIM.5.2) is a runtime result, logical/LTIM.5.2.runtime's.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event t1 where t1.entity_id == "a"
    Event t2 where t2.entity_id == "b" and t1.fired_at < t2.fired_at
->
    log info "t1 is older"
